conventions.convention: Adiabatic accessibility requires a model-admitted process witness with equilibrium endpoints and zero protocol-assigned heat; it does not mean zero work, isolation, or quasistatic evolution.

Scaled and joined tags retain distinct identities. Formal composition records primitive-label scale amounts; formal mass is their dimensionless sum. Separated compounds have permutation and reassociation identifications, and the empty unit has one state and mass zero.
Thermal equivalence means reversible accessibility between a separated pair and its energy-summing join; equality of numerical temperatures is not its definition.

Simple charts are nonempty open convex numerical domains with at least one work coordinate. Supporting planes have unique finite slopes, locally Lipschitz slope maps, and arcwise-connected relative sector boundaries.
C1 is an additional adopted assumption: an equilibrated join is thermally equivalent to each constituent. It is not inferred from the coordinate sum or transitivity alone.

Decorated-chain costs are infima of finite real witness costs: absent witnesses give +∞ and unbounded-below costs give −∞. No sinks means finite reachability in either direction occurs exactly when it occurs in the reverse direction.

The separated-product entropy is dimensionless and represents only equal-composition accessibility. Physical entropy units require an additional calibration; cross-type offsets establish only weak monotonicity under the extra network hypotheses.

load_bearing.statement: Adopt A1 reflexivity, A2 transitivity, A3 consistency with admitted common spectators, A4 positive scaling, A5 reversible splitting, and A6 fixed-spectator stability on declared equal-formal-mass comparisons. Cross-type comparisons are included only when a later channel network admits them.

A finite separated compound is a finite tuple of tagged scaled systems, with permutation and reassociation identifications and an empty unit type. Same composition means equality of primitive-label scale sums; formal mass is the dimensionless sum of all scale coefficients.

For every declared finite family of simple-system domains closed under thermal joins, assume A1–A7, S1–S3, T1–T5 and C1. For any two simple types i,j, strict endpoints exist with (x0,y1) equivalent to (x1,y0); every finite separated product made only from positive scaled copies of this fixed pair satisfies comparison hypothesis.

For a nonempty, possibly infinite primitive-label set, assume all finite separated products and finite thermal joins, the stated contact hypotheses on every finite join-closed subfamily, explicit finite-factor representation, and Choice. There is one dimensionless additive extensive entropy characterizing every equal-composition comparison; A7 gives concavity on admitted convex recombination regions.

For a nonempty finite-factor-closed reaction network with the stated finite baseline entropies, cross-type A1–A6, exact decorated-chain cost, no sinks, and Choice, there is an additive extensive real type offset B such that σΓ(x)+B(Γ) is nondecreasing across every admitted channel transition.

published_dependencies.used_for: Simultaneous reference-state, entropy-representative and calibrator choices, and the offset supplier's dominated and basis extensions.
The logarithm on strictly positive coordinates in the consistency witness.
Positive-base real powers in logarithmic sector boundary graphs.
Strict monotonicity, inverse identities, product laws and log 1 = 0 in both examples.
Logarithmic concavity and the equality condition determining the unique maximizing energy split.
Derivative monotonicity and tangent-support inequalities on closed intervals inside the positive-coordinate domains.

concerns.concern: The Definition quantifies a record P in the general admitted set P_s and requires Q[P]=0. Its cited supplier def-td-process-and-protocol defines Q and W_on only on P_cl(s), the core closed-record subclass with specified endpoint mass, velocities and zero kinetic/external-energy changes. No extension of Q to all P_s is supplied. The defining predicate therefore evaluates a function outside its declared domain unless the witness is restricted or an extended process class is explicitly defined.

The Statement assumes that 'every finite join-closed subfamily' satisfies the contact theorem. Literal nonempty finite join-closed families cannot exist with these tagged joins: repeatedly joining a positive-weight type to itself doubles its formal weight and retains increasing numbers of work coordinates. Thus the quantified condition can be vacuous and does not supply the contact premises for the pairs used in proof steps 1.1 and 2.1. The intended condition appears to concern the join closure of each finite set of generators, which is generally infinite; that condition is not stated.

The Statement's 'declared finite family ... closed under the thermal joins' has the same finiteness ambiguity as the entropy consumer: positive tagged weights and retained work coordinates make nonempty literal finite join closure impossible. Specify whether finite refers to primitive generators rather than the complete join-closed family.

Proof step 1.1 says that interpretations of J_(sΓ)(δ_s x) and sJ_Γ(x) are 'the same declared scaled preparation by composition of scaling maps.' The physical suppliers retain distinct scaled tags and supply coordinate multiplication, but do not explicitly give associative tag/preparation transport or reversible identification of nested scaling with multiplication of scale factors. The mathematical forward-sector supplier explicitly requires this transport. The proof should identify the physical assumption furnishing it rather than infer preparation identity from coordinate multiplication.

Steps 1.1 and 2.1 claim that (1,3) and (3,1), states of two unit copies of the same Γ, are incomparable. The cited def-td-scaled-products-and-comparison gives compounds permutation identifications. With no distinct copy-instance tags supplied here, these tuples represent the same separated compound, and the coefficient-map convention likewise encodes both as e_(Γ,1)+e_(Γ,3). The coordinate-sector relation therefore does not descend to the cited compound convention: it declares a representative inaccessible from another representative of the same state. Distinguishing ordered apparatus slots or selecting a witness with genuinely different factor multisets requires an explicit coherent convention.

The final sentence says 'The definition permits the channel set to be empty.' Earlier the Definition requires every X_T to be nonempty, defines accessibility exactly by existence of an admitted channel record, and adopts A1 reflexivity for that exact relation. An empty channel set provides no reflexive record even for the empty unit's sole state. The sentence needs qualification distinguishing absence of nonidentity cross-type channels from absence of every channel.

seams_checked.note: The mathematical carriers explicitly require A1–A7, S1–S3, T1–T5 and C1, weighted represented-state encoding, and the declared scaling transport. The physics Facts blocks preserve the pairwise scope, arbitrary-family Choice requirement, exact chain-cost convention, no-sinks hypothesis and weak offset conclusion. Draft status is stated honestly. Concerns separately identify insufficiently explicit physical transport and the finite join-closure quantifier used to discharge those premises.

The physical state embeddings, numerical SI coordinates, internal-energy convention and restricted bulk additivity are carried faithfully into the accessibility/contact exposition. However, def-td-adiabatic-accessibility applies Q to P in P_s, whereas def-td-process-and-protocol supplies Q only on P_cl(s). This is an actual domain mismatch at the framework-to-accessibility seam.
